measurement_note: Size is U = max(n, reverse(n)), the upper endpoint governing the required O(U log log U) sieve. Inputs 100, 400, and 1000 reverse to 1, 4, and 1, so each tier scans almost the complete prefix through U. The accepted sieve and an independent linear-space smallest-factor sieve meet the required class. A correct control tests every candidate by trial division through its square root, takes O(U sqrt U) time, completes all tiers, and is rejected only by scaling.
